episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: The premiere of the futuristic drama about an alien-occupied L.A.. First up: Will Sullivan attempts a daring rescue while Katie, his wife, tries to help a relative in need. In other events, a job opportunity threatens to divide the family.

episodes.title: A Brave New World
episodes.summary: Will faces unforeseen challenges on his first day at his new job; Katie receives her first assignment; Maddie reconnects with an old acquaintance; and Carlos pays the price for Will's collaboration.

episodes.title: 98 Seconds
episodes.summary: Katie's first mission forces her to question her commitment to the cause; Will's search for Geronimo doesn't sit well with the resistance; and Bram's girlfriend shares a secret with him.

episodes.title: Blind Spot
episodes.summary: Will continues to earn the respect of his new colleagues, but when his home comes under an attack, everyone is a suspect- even those closest to him. Meanwhile, Maddie finds a way in to the upper echelon.

episodes.title: Geronimo
episodes.summary: Geronimo's identity is revealed; Will begins to question Katie's loyalties; Bram finds his way into a secret world; and Snyder sees an opportunity to improve his standing.

episodes.title: Yoknapatawpha
episodes.summary: A resistance operation traps Will, Katie and Snyder in the Yonk and tests their allegiances.

episodes.title: Broussard
episodes.summary: Broussard questions his mentor, while separately Katie feels cut off from her family and her cell. During his hunt for the Resistance, Will comes even closer to discovering the truth. Up in the Green Zone, Maddie finds herself entangled in a seductive relationship. Finally, Snyder keeps his word, giving Will and Katie a glimmer of hope.

episodes.title: In from the Cold
episodes.summary: A high-ranking Resistance member is ready to cut a deal.

episodes.title: Zero Day
episodes.summary: Will comes up with a plan to get his family out from under the Occupation. Throwing a wrench in his best-laid plans, Katie and Broussard attempt to rekindle the fire of resistance by joining forces with a new cell. In a bold political move, Proxy Snyder fights to protect his office. Later, Maddie corners her boss in a precarious predicament.

episodes.title: Gateway
episodes.summary: After the Resistance kidnaps a high-value hostage, the Los Angeles bloc is placed on lockdown.

episodes.title: Eleven.Thirteen
episodes.summary: Alien intelligence are still in control of a near-future Los Angeles. In an effort to get their son back, Will has been cooperating with the Collaborators and now knows about his wife Katie's alliance with the Resistance. With her secret out and finding themselves on opposite sides of the battle, have they jeopardized any hope of reuniting their family?Meanwhile, Broussard returning home and Snyder receiving a job offer from a mysterious organization.

episodes.title: Somewhere Out There
episodes.summary: Will decides to trust an old friend; Jennifer visits Katie; and Bram meets the camp commandant.

episodes.title: Sublimation
episodes.summary: Will, Devon and Charlie try to get home; Katie, who fears the worst, says goodbye to her daughter; Bram makes friends at camp; Maddie finds a new project.

episodes.title: Panopticon
episodes.summary: Jennifer watches the Bowman house; when Charlie returns home, the family faces unexpected challenges.

episodes.title: Company Man
episodes.summary: Will returns to an unfamiliar workplace; Katie is on her best behavior; Broussard and his cell make a discovery about the Wall.

episodes.title: Fallout
episodes.summary: When the Resistance reaches out to Katie, Will chooses to help his wife bury her past. The labor camp gets a visit from Maddie and Nolan.

episodes.title: Free Radicals
episodes.summary: Bram embarks on a risky sabotage mission with his friends; Will faces the new Resistance; Kate learns a dark truth about the bloc.

episodes.title: Good Intentions
episodes.summary: Will and Katie must save a fugitive from the occupation. At the camp, Snyder hides evidence. Broussard's cell is threatened by one of their own.

episodes.title: Taman Shud
episodes.summary: Will and Katie attempt to make contact with a new arrival in the bloc; Bob has some questions for the Bowman family.

episodes.title: The Garden of Beasts
episodes.summary: Will, Katie and Broussard search for a way out of the colony; Maddie gets some visitors in the Green Zone; Bram looks for closure.

episodes.title: Lost Boy
episodes.summary: An attack on the Green Zone, told from five different points of view: Bram, Will, Maddie, Katie, and Ambassador King.

episodes.title: Seppuku
episodes.summary: Will, Katie, and Broussard battle the Red Hand for control of the RAP gauntlet; Snyder helps Helena regain control over the Los Angeles bloc.

episodes.title: Ronin
episodes.summary: In the Season 2 finale, a revelation about the fate of the colony forces the Bowman family to make an impossible choice.

episodes.title: Maquis
episodes.summary: Six months after escaping Los Angeles, the Bowmans and Snyder enjoy a simple life in the mountains until a sudden arrival changes everything.

episodes.title: Puzzle Man
episodes.summary: Will and Katie put themselves at risk to make contact with the Resistance; Broussard pieces together IGA secrets left behind in LA.

episodes.title: Sierra Maestra
episodes.summary: Will assesses the Resistance Camp's safety; Katie tries to get more involved; Broussard and Amy encounter survivors outside the walls.

episodes.title: Hospitium
episodes.summary: Will and Katie fear they might be in danger when the Resistance camp is put in lock down; a risky plan makes Broussard question Amy's intentions.

episodes.title: End of the Road
episodes.summary: Will, Katie, and Snyder struggle to protect their secrets while under interrogation.

episodes.title: The Emerald City
episodes.summary: The Bowman family encounters danger on the road to a possible new home. After getting a hero's welcome at IGA headquarters, Snyder settles into retirement.

episodes.title: A Clean, Well-Lighted Place
episodes.summary: Will follows clues that may expose a dangerous secret about the Seattle Colony; Katie helps a refugee family; Bram steps in as a parent to Gracie. Conspiracy emerges again.

episodes.title: Lazarus
episodes.summary: Katie suspects there might be a dark side to her refugee case work; Will helps Broussard and Amy with a Resistance operation; Snyder goes back to work for the IGA; Bram starts a new job.

episodes.title: The Big Empty
episodes.summary: Will, Broussard, Amy, and Bram work together to kidnap a high-ranking IGA officer.

episodes.title: Sea Spray
episodes.summary: Will and Katie question whether their family is safe in Seattle. Snyder digs up dirt on Everett Kynes. Amy parts ways with Broussard.

episodes.title: Disposable Heroes
episodes.summary: Will, Broussard, Katie, and Amy help the Outliers deal with an emergency. Snyder makes his play to take over Seattle. Kynes runs damage control.

episodes.title: Bonzo
episodes.summary: Will and the Outliers fight to save Kynes from Snyder's IGA army.

episodes.title: What Goes Around
episodes.summary: Will makes a sacrifice to protect his family; Katie races to save refugees outside the walls; Snyder struggles to control a Colony amidst the chaos of war; Bram and Gracie make a big decision.
